title: Initials
starter:
def initials(first: str, last: str) -> str:
    return first + last
hints: The first letter of a string `s` is `s[0]`.
An f-string puts values between plain text: `f"{a}.{b}."`.
explain: The reference is `f"{first[0]}.{last[0]}."`. Index 0 is the first character, and the f-string glues the two letters and the dots together. Keep the letters as they are: the tests expect `'g.h.'` for lowercase names.
